facts.fact: Actualite.cd reported that on 12 July 2024 ANICNS handed digital kits to three Kinshasa facilities, the Lufungula general hospital (10 computers) and the Ngaba mother-and-child centre and Lufungula health centre (5 computers between them), with three hospital information systems and an internet connection, to allow the first modules of the hospital information system, those for free maternity and newborn care, to be implemented and to guarantee portability of the computerised patient record.

Actualite.cd states that the ANICNS initiative supplying computers and hospital management software to Kinshasa facilities is financed from the Congolese government's own funds, and is planned to extend to more than a hundred hospital establishments in Kinshasa and progressively to other provinces; no amount or budget line is given.

Actualite.cd presents the supply of hospital information systems to Kinshasa facilities as an initiative of the national agency ANICNS, carried out with the provincial health division; the document does not name the ministry itself.
